production.order: Generate the seven scenes first (each needs four separate, tappable targets) and inspect them at full size and phone size, then the kickoff and the four question/response pairs.

shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.party: Ana's family party in the sunny green garden behind her house on a warm afternoon: a long table with a white tablecloth, plates and a big cake, colorful paper lanterns and a few balloons hang from the trees, with no letters or numbers anywhere.
shared_prompts.scene4: This is a wide scene for a listening game: the learner hears one sentence and taps the person, pair, group or animal it describes, so the four described subjects must be clearly separate from each other, none hidden behind another, none cut off by the photo's edges, with their heads well below the top edge. Nobody looks at the camera.
shared_prompts.solo-cast: The person is a recurring course character, so the face must match the reference exactly.
shared_prompts.solo-family: The person is Ana's relative from an earlier lesson, so the face must match the reference exactly.

assets.item: M01 guided search: He is tall. / She has long hair. / She is short. / He has a beard.
assets.prompt: Four adult guests arrive at the garden party and stand on the grass in one row with wide, clear space between them, each seen from head to feet, smiling, in three-quarter view. From left to right: a VERY TALL young man of about 30 with short light-brown hair and a light-blue shirt, clearly the tallest by a head; a young woman of about 25 with VERY LONG straight black hair falling to her waist, in a white summer dress; a SHORT older woman of about 60 with short grey hair and a red cardigan, clearly the shortest, her head only at the others' shoulder height; and a man of about 50, of average height, with a BIG THICK dark-brown BEARD, in a brown jacket. Nobody else is in the photo.

assets.item: M02: He is old. / She is young. / She is old. / He is young.
assets.prompt: Four family guests sit at the garden party with clear space between them, each one fully visible, on a long wooden garden bench and two garden chairs. From left to right: a very OLD man of about 85 with white hair, no beard, a grey sweater; a YOUNG girl of about 7 with two braids and a yellow dress; a very OLD woman of about 85 with short white curly hair and a blue blouse; and a YOUNG man of about 17 with short black hair and a green T-shirt. Nobody else is in the photo.

assets.item: M03: He drinks coffee. / She eats cake. / He cooks chicken. / She reads a book.
assets.prompt: Four adult guests at the garden party, spread out across the scene with clear space between them, each fully visible and each doing ONE clear thing. From left to right: a man in a striped shirt sits at a small round table and drinks coffee from a white mug; a woman in a pink blouse stands and eats a slice of chocolate cake with a fork from a small plate; a man in a white apron stands at a barbecue grill and cooks pieces of chicken, turning them with tongs, a little smoke rising; and a woman in a blue dress sits in a wooden garden chair and reads an open book with a plain green cover. Nobody else is in the photo.

assets.item: M04: The girl swims. / The boy runs. / The man sings. / The woman dances.
assets.prompt: The garden party next to a small backyard swimming pool. Four people spread across the scene with clear space between them, each doing ONE clear thing. From left to right: a girl of about 10 swims in the pool, her head and arms above the clear blue water; a boy of about 8 runs fast across the grass, one foot off the ground; a man of about 40 sits on a chair and sings, mouth open, playing an acoustic guitar; and a woman of about 40 dances alone on the grass, arms up, her skirt swinging. Nobody else is in the photo.

assets.item: M05: The dog plays with its ball. / The cat is on its bed. / The bird drinks its water. / The rabbit eats its food.
assets.prompt: The garden party with FOUR PETS and no people, spread across the scene with clear space between them, each animal large and easy to see. From left to right: a tan dog with a red collar plays with its yellow tennis ball on the grass, the ball in its mouth; a grey-and-white cat lies awake on its own round grey cat bed on the stone patio; a small white birdcage stands on a low garden table close to the camera, and inside it a yellow-and-green parakeet drinks from its small water dish, its beak in the water; and a white-and-brown rabbit eats its food, lettuce and carrot pieces, from its own small blue bowl on the grass.

assets.item: M06: She dances with him. / He plays football with them. / She reads with her. / He cooks with her.
assets.prompt: Four separate groups at the garden party, spread across the scene from left to right with clear space between the groups, everyone fully visible. Group 1 (left): a woman in a red dress dances with a man in a white shirt, holding hands. Group 2: a man in a yellow T-shirt plays football with two small children, a boy and a girl, a black-and-white ball at their feet. Group 3: an old woman with white hair sits on a bench and reads a picture book with a little girl of about 6. Group 4 (right): a man in a white apron and a woman in a green blouse cook together at a barbecue grill, side by side. Nobody else is in the photo.

assets.item: M07 contrast hunt: He doesn't drink coffee. He drinks tea. / She drinks coffee. / He drinks water. / She drinks juice.
assets.prompt: Four guests sit side by side along one long side of the party table, facing the camera, with clear space between them, each holding ONE drink in both hands at chest height so the drink is large and easy to see. From left to right: a man of about 35 in a blue shirt holds a clear glass cup of light amber TEA, a tea bag string and paper tag hanging over the rim; a woman of about 35 in a green blouse holds a clear glass mug of black COFFEE; a man of about 60 in a grey shirt holds a tall clear glass of WATER; and a young woman of about 25 in an orange top holds a tall glass of bright ORANGE JUICE. Nobody else is in the photo.
